answer: Reef-latency arrival shaping. Each agent identity must answer a challenge within a jittered window derived from its claimed network position, so responses arrive as a smooth, hollow-free arrival curve. Bursts of near-identical timing expose coordinated clones, which are throttled. An attacker must provision genuinely distinct, opal-grade timing paths per sybil, paying real latency and infrastructure cost per identity, not one shared shortcut.
